name: GOB
recent: Global Oriental Berhad 最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收环比下降32.5%至3012万令吉，并录得726万令吉净亏损。公司于2026年9月5日召开第23届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。近期新闻亦报道其2027财年第二季净亏损780万令吉、营收下滑17.8%。
notable: 第23届常年股东大会于2026年9月5日举行，所有决议均获股东通过。
最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收环比下降32.5%至3012万令吉，并录得净亏损726万令吉。
risks: 最新季度由盈转亏，净亏损726万令吉，净利率为-24.1%。
营收环比下降32.5%，同比亦下降7.8%。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，营收为3012万令吉，环比下降32.5%，同比下降7.8%；净亏损726万令吉，净利率-24.1%，上一季度净利率为10.5%。

recent_en: Global Oriental Berhad's latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) saw revenue fall 32.5% QoQ to RM30.12 million and a net loss of RM7.26 million. The company held its 23rd AGM on 5 September 2026, with all resolutions passed. Recent news also reported a 2Q FY2027 net loss of RM7.80 million and a 17.8% revenue decline.
notable_en: The 23rd AGM was held on 5 September 2026 and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
The latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) saw revenue fall 32.5% QoQ to RM30.12 million and a net loss of RM7.26 million.
risks_en: The latest quarter swung to a net loss of RM7.26 million, with a net margin of -24.1%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM30.12 million, down 32.5% QoQ and 7.8% YoY; net loss was RM7.26 million with a net margin of -24.1%, versus a net margin of 10.5% in the prior quarter.
